statusEffectDatabase.engine_notes: Stun locks all action-through-hero declarations and activations. Passive Hero Abilities remain active while legal. statusEffectDatabase.duration_rule: Decrease duration during the End Phase of the buffed Hero owner. When duration reaches 0, move the Buff Card to discard.
statusEffectDatabase.engine_notes: Passive Hero Abilities, Rank effects, Racial Traits, Exhaust, Casting Mode, and negative statuses are not temporary Buffs by default. If both Attachment Slots are occupied, a new Buff is illegal.

targetingRules.description: In Quick Mode, positioning restrictions are removed and all active heroes may attack any opponent active hero.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Any opponent active hero

targetingRules.description: In Quick Mode, AoE affects all opponent active heroes and does not use LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT coverage.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: All opponent active heroes

targetingRules.description: In Main Mode, Reposition normally uses adjacent swaps during Deploy Phase or Reform Phase.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: LEFT<->CENTER;CENTER<->RIGHT

targetingRules.description: LEFT and RIGHT cannot swap directly unless a card explicitly allows it.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Not allowed: LEFT<->RIGHT

targetingRules.description: At least one non-Exhausted active hero must initiate Reposition. Legacy may participate but cannot satisfy the active hero requirement.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Non-Exhausted active allied hero plus adjacent battlefield card

targetingRules.description: Frozen heroes cannot initiate Reposition and cannot be moved by allied Reposition.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: No Reposition for Frozen hero

targetingRules.description: Stunned heroes cannot initiate Reposition and cannot be moved unless a card says otherwise.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: No Reposition for Stunned hero

targetingRules.description: Single-target Casting checks legal Battle Phase Area access when declared, then locks the target Hero Zone rather than a specific Hero. Resolve against the locked-zone occupant without retargeting.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Legal opponent Hero Zone at declaration; locked-zone occupant at resolution

targetingRules.description: AoE Casting does not lock a target position. It resolves against currently valid active heroes in caster coverage.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Current active heroes in AoE coverage

targetingRules.description: Redirect changes the target of a single-target attack if the new target is legal. AoE normally cannot be redirected. After legal Redirect declaration/resolution, recalculate the current target immediately and open the final response window.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Legal redirecting hero for single-target attack

targetingRules.description: Legacy Cards are not active heroes and cannot normally be targeted, damaged, healed, buffed, debuffed, or receive statuses.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Legacy normally invalid target

targetingRules.description: Healing may target active allied Heroes unless prevented by Bleed or another restriction. Outside Battle Phase, LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT geometry is ignored. Battle Phase healing follows Area unless printed text explicitly says all ... Heroes or provides another override.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Legal active allied Hero without healing restriction

targetingRules.description: Untargetable prevents opponent single-target attacks and single-target negative effects from selecting that hero. It does not stop AoE, allied effects, self effects, global effects, or existing statuses.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Cannot be selected by opponent single-target attack/effect

targetingRules.description: When card text says opponent in attack/status/damage context, map it to the relevant opponent-controlled hero/object while still following legal access.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Target hero;damaged hero;affected active heroes;opponent resource/hand/deck/discard as context requires

targetingRules.description: Some effects can refer to a Skill with Casting Time in a Hero Attachment Slot. This selector points only to unresolved Casting Skill Cards when a card effect specifically says so.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Unresolved Casting Skill Card in target Hero Attachment Slot

targetingRules.description: A Racial Trait may be used as a response if its printed text allows it. It follows normal chain limits and spends the player once-per-turn Racial Trait activation from the shared Racial Token pool.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Targets allowed by printed Racial Trait text

targetingRules.description: Unless card text explicitly excludes the acting hero, an effect that targets an allied hero may target the acting hero itself.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Any legal allied active hero, including the acting hero unless excluded

targetingRules.description: Legacy replacement is not package-bound. A defeated hero may be replaced only by an available Legacy Card matching that hero's Rank I base class or base class family.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Available Legacy Card matching defeated hero Rank I base class/class family

targetingRules.description: Effects written as Area follow positional coverage when resolved during Battle Phase. Effects written as all ... Heroes are global and ignore positioning coverage.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Area: covered active heroes only; all ... heroes: every matching hero

targetingRules.description: Normal adjacent active-hero swap requires both heroes non-Exhausted and legally movable; both become Exhausted. Multiple swaps are legal if each swap is individually legal.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Adjacent active hero zones

targetingRules.description: Adjacent active hero <-> Legacy swap requires only the active hero non-Exhausted and legally movable; that active hero becomes Exhausted. Legacy cannot become Exhausted.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Adjacent active hero and Legacy zones

targetingRules.description: Single-target Casting locks the targeted Hero Zone. Resolve against the active hero occupying that zone; if a Legacy occupies it, resolve without damage or negative status. Do not retarget.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Locked Hero Zone occupant at resolution

targetingRules.description: While Taunt is active, legal single-target attacks against that side must target the Taunt hero. Area attacks and global multi-target Attack effects against that side are illegal. Non-Attack effects remain legal.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Taunt hero for single-target attacks

targetingRules.description: Double Casting is activated during Deploy Phase and does not Exhaust its user. During that turn's Battle Phase, when that Hero plays its next legal Single Target Attack Skill, pay that Skill's mana cost once and resolve it as 2 attacks. Resolve each attack separately with its own DEF Response Window. For the Elementalist Rank II row, both attacks use the same legal target and the +2 Mana surcharge applies only to Double Casting itself. For the Elemental Lord Rank III row, each attack may choose a different legal target.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Rank II: same legal opponent Hero twice; Rank III: each attack may choose a legal opponent Hero

targetingRules.description: Quick Mode disables Reposition because LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT geometry has no gameplay effect.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: No Reposition in Quick Mode

targetingRules.targeting_name: Skill Card Buff Allied Target Exception
targetingRules.description: For the current S1B1 card pool, a Skill Card buff may choose any legal allied active hero regardless of LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT. Printed target restrictions still apply. Self-only buffs remain self-only. Legacy Cards cannot receive buffs.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Any legal allied active hero allowed by printed Skill Card text

targetingRules.description: Cover Up may Redirect a legal single-target attack to a legal Warrior Hero. After target recalculation, Chain Mail may be used as the final response on the redirected Hero if the attack is Physical, the Hero satisfies Chain Mail class-family restriction, the Hero is not prevented by Exhaust, Stun, or Casting Mode, and the 3-step chain still has the final-response slot available.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Redirected legal Warrior/Archer/Rogue allied hero receiving a Physical single-target attack

targetingRules.description: A Hero cannot receive a new Buff if both Attachment Slots are occupied.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Active allied Hero with at least 1 free Attachment Slot

targetingRules.description: A Hero cannot receive a Buff if that Hero already has an active Buff of the same effect type, even if the incoming Buff has a different card name.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Active allied Hero without an existing Buff of that effect type

targetingRules.description: Holy Resurgence and Radiant Oblivion select exactly 1 allied active Hero within the activating Hero Area. Self-target is legal.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: One allied active Hero in activating Hero Area, including self

targetingRules.description: A proactive SUPPORT Skill Card is used during Deploy Phase or Reform Phase and ignores positional geometry. Self-target remains legal when printed restrictions allow it. Effects worded all ... Heroes remain global. Legacy Cards are not normal SUPPORT targets unless printed revival text says otherwise.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Legal allied target(s) without LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT restriction

targetingRules.description: After Holy Ring resolves successfully, the opponent cannot target that Hero with attacks during their next turn. Treat the protected Hero as an illegal direct-attack target, not as a 0-damage target.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Opponent attack targets excluding Holy Ring protected Hero; Area attacks unaffected if otherwise legal

targetingRules.targeting_name: ST Casting Locked Zone into Legacy
targetingRules.description: A single-target Casting / delayed attack locks the Hero Zone at declaration. If a Legacy occupies that zone at resolution, announce the Legacy resolution, deal no damage/status, and do not retarget.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Locked Hero Zone occupant at resolution; Legacy receives no damage/status

targetingRules.description: Legacy Cards cannot be selected as normal direct attack targets. Display them as illegal targets during opponent Hero selection.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Active opponent Heroes only for normal direct attacks

targetingRules.description: Cards declared during Battle Phase that choose Hero Zones follow the user Hero Area unless printed text explicitly says all ... Heroes.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: LEFT -> LEFT/CENTER; CENTER -> LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT; RIGHT -> CENTER/RIGHT

targetingRules.description: Scouting may target only an opponent Hero with at least 1 removable non-Ultimate Tribute EXP Card. A Hero whose stack contains only Ultimate EXP Cards is not a legal Scouting target.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Opponent Hero with >=1 non-Ultimate Tribute EXP Card

targetingRules.targeting_name: Buff SUPPORT User and Receiver Separation
targetingRules.description: For a Buff SUPPORT Skill such as Blessing of Might, first choose the legal Skill user, then choose the legal allied receiving Hero. The Skill user becomes Exhausted at declaration unless printed text says otherwise. The receiving Hero does not become Exhausted merely for receiving the Buff.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Any legal allied active receiving Hero allowed by printed Buff restriction; independent from the chosen Skill user

targetingRules.targeting_name: Casting Declaration and Legacy Resolution Notice
targetingRules.description: A Casting / delayed attack announces its locked Hero Zone to the opponent at declaration. If an active Hero occupies that zone at resolution, open the normal Response Window directly. If Legacy or no active Hero occupies the zone, report the no-effect resolution and do not open Response Window or retarget.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Locked Hero Zone occupant at resolution; Legacy and empty zone receive no damage or status

targetingRules.targeting_name: Relentless Leveling during Idle Multi-Turn Casting
targetingRules.description: Relentless Leveling is a narrow Casting Mode Event exception. Its own Hero user may declare and resolve the Event only during an idle turn of multi-turn Casting in which that Hero neither declares nor resolves Casting, if at least 1 Attachment Slot remains empty. Resolve the printed one-shot EXP Tribute, then move Relentless Leveling to discard. It does not remain attached.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Exactly 1 allied active Hero user; while multi-turn Casting is unresolved, only an idle non-declaration, non-resolution turn with at least 1 empty Attachment Slot is legal

targetingRules.targeting_name: Execute Declaration and Resolution HP Check
targetingRules.description: Execute may only be declared against an opponent Hero whose current HP is half or less of Max HP. Re-check the same threshold at resolution after responses. If the declaration threshold is not met, do not spend Mana, Exhaust the user, discard Execute, or open a Response Window.
targetingRules.allowed_targets: Opponent active Hero with current HP <= 50% Max HP at declaration; re-check at resolution

deckRules.description: Main Deck is exactly 50 cards.
Official Legacy Deck is exactly 20 cards from complete class progression packages.

deckRules.rule_value: Dynamic reference pool; constructed Legacy Deck = exactly 20 cards
deckRules.description: The reference pool contains all currently implemented Hero Cards and Legacy Cards and may expand as new progression variants or Legacy Cards are added. This does not change official Legacy Deck construction: exactly 5 progression packages, with Rank I Hero + Rank II Hero + Rank III Hero + 1 matching Legacy Card per package, for exactly 20 cards total.
Main Deck default maximum is 2 copies per card name unless a card specifies a lower limit. Legacy Deck Cards are a stricter exception: maximum 1 copy per Legacy Card name.
Each player starts with 6 cards.
Players discard down to 8 cards during End Phase.
There is currently no mulligan system.
Each player starts with 2 mana shards.
Main Mode starts with Mana Regen 1.
Quick Mode starts with Mana Regen 1.
Maximum Mana Regen is 6.
Maximum Mana Storage is 12 mana shards.
Each player starts with 2 total Racial Tokens shared across their 3 heroes.
Current turn structure.
Chain limit: initial action, response, and final response. After Redirect, recalculate target and use the remaining final-response slot normally.
The first player cannot use offensive or disruptive actions against the opponent during first turn.
A player loses only if they must draw during Draw Phase and cannot draw because Main Deck is empty.

Each active Hero has exactly 2 Attachment Slots. In Season 1, an unresolved Casting Card occupies 1 Attachment Slot until resolution, failure, or cancellation. A temporary Buff Card occupies 1 Attachment Slot while that Buff remains active, then moves to discard when its duration reaches 0. Attachment occupancy by itself does not prevent actions. A Hero in Casting Mode normally cannot declare proactive Skill, Item, Event, Reposition, or Activated Hero Ability actions. Relentless Leveling is the explicit Event exception: its own Hero user may use it only during an idle turn of multi-turn Casting in which that Hero neither declares nor resolves Casting, if at least 1 Attachment Slot remains empty. The Event resolves as a one-shot EXP Tribute and does not remain attached. Legacy Cards do not have active Attachment Slots.
A player may activate only 1 Racial Trait per turn. Choose 1 eligible active hero and pay the required cost from that player-owned Racial Token pool.

When a hero reaches the required EXP threshold, Rank Up is mandatory according to the normal legal timing. Normally only 1 Tribute and 1 Rank Up may be performed during Reform Phase unless a card explicitly overrides the rule.
An Ultimate Skill Card is a Skill Card with an EXP value of 200. It has a playable Rank II class row and an upgraded Rank III class row. The ULTIMATE badge is a visual identifier.
A Main Deck may include a maximum of 1 Ultimate Skill Card for each base Skill class. This is a stricter deckbuilding limit than the default maximum 2 copies per card name.

deckRules.rule_name: Hybrid Class base Skill class Access
deckRules.description: A Hybrid Class does not create a new base Skill class. A Hybrid Hero may use the base Skill classes listed on that Hero Card. Paladin and Crusader currently use Warrior and Cleric base Skill classes.

deckRules.rule_value: Match printed Skill class rows against Hero active class lineage
deckRules.description: A Hero may use a Skill Card when at least 1 printed class row on that card appears in the Hero active class lineage. If multiple rows match, use the row with the highest lineage specificity depth. The Rank label beside a printed class row identifies that row effect tier; it is not an exact-rank gate unless a separate explicit requirement says so. Example: Saint matches a Cleric row; Crusader matches Warrior, Cleric, Paladin, and Crusader rows where printed.

A class progression package is a deckbuilding-count structure: 1 possible Rank I Hero, 1 possible Rank II Hero, 1 possible Rank III Hero, and 1 Legacy slot matching that Rank I base class/class family. It is not a locked origin bundle.

When a hero is defeated, choose 1 available Legacy Card from the Legacy Deck that matches that hero's Rank I base class or base class family. A Warrior -> Gladiator -> Conqueror hero and a Warrior -> Paladin -> Crusader hero may choose Warrior-family Legacy options, but cannot choose Mage-family or Cleric-family Legacy options.
Any action, ability, or card use that causes Exhaust cannot be declared by a hero who is already Exhausted.

Hero Abilities are effects printed on Hero Cards. Their timing, activation requirements, limits, costs, and targets follow the Hero Card text. Passive abilities remain active while legal. Activated abilities do not occupy an Attachment Slot.

deckRules.rule_name: Activated Hero Ability Casting Mode Restriction
deckRules.description: A Hero in Casting Mode cannot use an Activated Hero Ability. Passive Hero Abilities remain active while legal. Attachment Slot occupancy from Buff Cards alone does not disable an Activated Hero Ability.

A Racial Trait may be used as a response if its text allows it. A Reactive Racial Trait follows the normal chain limit and still consumes that player's once-per-turn Racial Trait activation from the shared player-owned Racial Token pool.

deckRules.rule_name: Ultimate Skill Normal Interactions and Tribute Restriction
deckRules.rule_value: Matching Class Lineage only; no Racial Token cost
deckRules.description: Ultimate Skill Cards may be Tributed during Reform Phase for 200 EXP only to a Hero in that card's Class Lineage. This Tribute does not cost a Racial Token. Relentless Leveling and Déjà vu still exclude Ultimate Skill Cards as printed anti-snowball exceptions.

deckRules.rule_name: Legacy Deck Cards Never Enter Discard
deckRules.description: A Legacy Deck card never enters the discard pile. When it leaves the field, return it to the Legacy Deck unless another rule requires it to remain stacked with a related card.
When EXP reaches the required threshold, Rank Up resolves immediately. There is no optional delayed eligible state.
Each player owns one player-side Racial Token pool with maximum 2 tokens and may activate only 1 Racial Trait per player turn.

deckRules.rule_value: No same-type active Buff; no overwrite
deckRules.description: A Hero cannot receive a temporary Buff if that Hero already has an active Buff of the same effect type, even when the new Buff comes from a different card name. An active Buff cannot be overwritten, refreshed, or extended by applying another same-type Buff. A new Buff of that type becomes legal only after the existing Buff leaves its Attachment Slot. If both Attachment Slots are occupied, that Hero cannot receive another Buff.

In Main Mode, Reposition may normally occur during Deploy Phase or Reform Phase. Reposition remains an adjacent swap only: LEFT <-> CENTER or CENTER <-> RIGHT. Existing Exhaust, Freeze, Stun, Casting Mode, Legacy-pivot, and true 1v1 auto-center restrictions remain active.
Quick Mode disables Reposition. LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT may remain visible as layout labels, but positional geometry has no gameplay effect.

deckRules.rule_value: Deploy Phase; Reform Phase by default; Deploy Phase only for battle-related or temporary buff/debuff Events unless printed text says otherwise
deckRules.description: Non-Reactive Event Cards may normally be used during the owner Deploy Phase or Reform Phase. Battle-related or temporary buff/debuff Events are Deploy Phase only unless their printed text explicitly says otherwise. Reactive Events follow their printed timing.

A Stunned hero cannot declare, activate, or continue actions through that hero. This includes ATK, SUPPORT, Tactical, DEF responses, Event and Item use through that hero, Activated Hero Abilities, Racial Traits activated through that hero, Reposition, and continuing Casting. Passive Hero Abilities remain active while legal.
Stamina Potion may target an Exhausted hero and removes Exhaust. Removing Exhaust does not grant an additional proactive Skill use during that turn unless an effect explicitly says otherwise.
Magic Compass lets its user choose 1 Skill Card from their deck and add that chosen Skill Card to their hand.

Scouting chooses an opponent hero, then discards 1 non-Ultimate EXP Card stacked under that hero. That hero loses the discarded EXP value. Ultimate EXP Cards cannot be discarded. Mandatory immediate Rank Up prevents a pending eligible state.

deckRules.rule_name: Double Casting Deploy Setup and Resolution
deckRules.rule_value: Deploy activation; 1 ST Attack Skill paid once; resolve as 2 attacks
deckRules.description: Double Casting is activated during Deploy Phase and does not Exhaust its user. During that turn's Battle Phase, when that Hero plays its next legal Single Target Attack Skill, pay that Skill's mana cost once and resolve it as 2 attacks. Resolve each attack separately with its own DEF Response Window. For the Elementalist Rank II row, both attacks use the same legal target and the +2 Mana surcharge applies only to Double Casting itself. For the Elemental Lord Rank III row, each attack may choose a different legal target.

For the current S1B1 card pool, Skill Card effects that apply a buff may choose any legal allied active hero regardless of LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT position. Printed restrictions still apply. Self-only buffs remain self-only. Legacy Cards cannot receive buffs.
All proactive Tactical Skill Cards are used during the owner Deploy Phase by default and normally Exhaust their hero user at declaration. Reactive Tactical Skill Cards follow printed timing.

Final Grit is a proactive Tactical Skill used during Deploy Phase through the matching Legacy/defeated Gladiator-Conqueror stack. Return that Legacy to Legacy Deck, revive the matching hero with 10 HP Exhausted, and preserve the once-per-same-hero restriction. It cannot save the final defeated active hero because the loss check resolves first.

deckRules.rule_value: Cover Up into Chain Mail legal
deckRules.description: After a legal Redirect, recalculate the current target immediately and open the final response window. Cover Up into Chain Mail is legal within the 3-step chain if all card restrictions are met. A Redirect can only be canceled by a legal effect that explicitly cancels it or the relevant DEF response.
Each active Hero has 2 Attachment Slots. A Hero with both Attachment Slots occupied cannot receive a new Buff. Casting Cards and active Buff Cards count toward this capacity.

deckRules.rule_value: Action lock while Casting with idle-turn Relentless Leveling exception
deckRules.description: A Hero with an unresolved Casting Card is in Casting Mode. Casting Mode normally prevents proactive actions. Relentless Leveling is legal only during an idle turn of multi-turn Casting in which that Hero neither declares nor resolves Casting and at least 1 Attachment Slot remains empty.

Proactive SUPPORT Skill Cards are used during Deploy Phase or Reform Phase. They ignore LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT positional geometry. Printed all ... Heroes wording remains global. Legacy Cards cannot be normal SUPPORT targets unless printed revival text says otherwise.

deckRules.rule_value: Cannot target protected Hero with attacks next turn
deckRules.description: After Holy Ring resolves successfully, the opponent cannot target that Hero with attacks during their next turn. This is attack-target prevention, not 0 damage or damage immunity. Area attacks remain unaffected if otherwise legal.

A single-target Casting / delayed attack locks a Hero Zone at declaration. If a Legacy occupies that locked zone at resolution, resolve with no damage or status and do not retarget. Announce the locked zone and resolution result.

deckRules.rule_value: Rank I 0; Rank II 300; Rank III 700
deckRules.description: When a Hero is revived by a legal revival Skill, Item, or effect, that Hero returns with baseline EXP for its current rank: Rank I 0, Rank II 300, Rank III 700.

Temporary proactive Skill Card Buffs such as Blessing of Might, Blessing of Wisdom, and Heaven's Fury are used during Deploy Phase or Reform Phase. Their position-independent targeting remains active.

deckRules.rule_name: Hammer of Justice Class Lineage Resolution
deckRules.description: Hammer of Justice follows Class Lineage Check. Cleric, Priest, and Saint match the Cleric Rank I row and deal 60 Magical Attack damage. Paladin and Crusader match both Cleric and Paladin rows, then use the more-specific Paladin Rank II row and deal 70 Magical Attack damage.

After Unbroken Stand resolves, its receiving Hero is immune to negative statuses until End Phase. The card still Blocks only its printed damage amount; damage prevention and status immunity are separate effects.
Scouting cannot target a Hero with no removable non-Ultimate Tribute EXP Card. A Hero whose stacked EXP consists only of Ultimate Tribute cards is not a legal target.

deckRules.rule_value: Deploy Phase and Reform Phase effects ignore LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT geometry unless printed text explicitly says otherwise.
deckRules.description: Deploy Phase and Reform Phase effects ignore LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT geometry unless printed text explicitly says otherwise.

deckRules.rule_value: Battle Phase effects follow positional Area unless printed text explicitly says all ... Heroes or gives another override.
deckRules.description: Battle Phase effects follow positional Area unless printed text explicitly says all ... Heroes or gives another override.

deckRules.rule_value: Holy Resurgence and Radiant Oblivion are Deploy Phase single-target heals that may choose any allied active Hero including self.
deckRules.description: Holy Resurgence and Radiant Oblivion are Deploy Phase single-target heals that may choose any allied active Hero including self.

deckRules.rule_value: Immediate on defeat / HP reaches 0; no delayed activation
deckRules.description: When a Hero with Stoneblood is defeated or reaches 0 HP, its owner may immediately spend 1 Racial Token to revive that same Hero with 10 HP Exhausted. This is a one-time decision at the defeat event. If it is not activated then, it cannot be activated during a later turn. Stoneblood can only be used once for the same Hero. Resolve before normal Legacy replacement.

deckRules.rule_value: Maximum 1 copy per Legacy Card name
deckRules.description: Legacy replacement eligibility is determined by Rank I base class/class family, not by the Hero variant that originally contributed the package slot. Multiple packages from the same class family are legal only when their Hero progression variants are different. However, each Legacy Card name may appear at most once in the entire Legacy Deck.

Rank I / Rank II / Rank III printed beside a Skill class row identifies the effect tier of that row. Descendant classes may still use an earlier row through Class Lineage Check. A true minimum-rank or exact-rank restriction must be written separately as an explicit requirement.

deckRules.rule_value: Authoring conflict unless resolved by more-specific row
deckRules.description: If a Hybrid Hero matches multiple printed class rows at the same lineage depth and those rows produce conflicting effects, do not let runtime guess. Card authoring must provide a more-specific hybrid row or make equal-depth rows identical.

Quick Mode ignores LEFT / CENTER / RIGHT positional geometry. When a Quick Mode game reaches true 1v1, do not run Main Mode auto-center movement logic. Continue play without positional movement processing.

deckRules.rule_value: This Hero or 1 legal allied Hero in Battle Area
deckRules.description: Holy Barrier may Block damage dealt to the Priest / Saint user or to 1 allied receiving Hero inside that user Hero Battle Phase positional Area. It is not self-only. Quick Mode ignores positional geometry while preserving allied-target legality.

deckRules.rule_value: ST 10 x duration; AoE 20 x duration
deckRules.description: Poison has dedicated utility values across all ranks: Single Target Poison = 10 x duration; Area Poison = 20 x duration. Poison is no longer derived from generic low bad-status rank scaling.

deckRules.rule_value: Each Hero has exactly 1 fixed Rank I-to-III progression path
deckRules.description: A class may have multiple Class Lineages, but each Hero belongs to only 1 fixed Class Lineage. Example: Draxen follows Warrior > Gladiator > Conqueror; Aurex follows Warrior > Paladin > Crusader. Draxen cannot become Crusader and Aurex cannot become Conqueror.
You may only Tribute this card to a Hero in its Class Lineage. Rank I Heroes may receive the Tribute when they belong to the matching fixed Class Lineage.

deckRules.rule_value: 20 normally; 40 with 3 different active base classes; maximum 1 per Area Attack
deckRules.description: When your opponent uses an Area Attack, reduce its damage by 20. If your active Heroes have 3 different base classes, reduce it by 40 instead. Only one Defensive Formation may be used against each Area Attack.

deckRules.rule_value: Target HP must be half or less at declaration and resolution
deckRules.description: Execute may only be declared against an opponent Hero whose current HP is half or less of Max HP. Check before cost payment, Exhaust, discard, or Response Window. Re-check at resolution.
